title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE BELT KEYS
why: The card was stamped v25.93 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v25.93 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind. Its new line names the builds since: the belt keys and keycaps, the gold rings (his orders 2026-10-13) and crouch regen (his order).
now: The what is new card names the belt keys.
